primary_result: The joint three-action utility-risk policy failed the frozen development contract. Its worse-operator gain was +0.000830 dB point with LCB95 -0.000241 dB, oracle retention was 0.00535 point with LCB95 -0.00154, and coverage was 9.31% point with LCB95 8.01%. It selected the negative action zero times and produced -0.00518 dB point gain on the negative-oracle subset with LCB95 -0.00771 dB. Safety gates passed with zero severe and hard cases and a severe-rate one-sided UCB95 of 0.
gate_reasons: Gain LCB95 -0.000241 dB failed the +0.020 dB gate.
True-minus-sign-shuffle LCB95 +0.001712 dB failed the +0.005 dB specificity gate.
Joint-minus-independent LCB95 -0.000241 dB failed the +0.005 dB increment gate.
Negative-oracle-subset gain LCB95 -0.007708 dB failed the strict positive gate, with zero negative-action selections.
Coverage LCB95 0.080078 failed the 0.10 minimum coverage gate.
Safety, severe-rate, native-shape and structural/access gates passed, but PASS required every formal gate.
competing_explanation: The evidence favors conservative abstention without signed-action identification over the proposed joint signed utility-risk mechanism. The risk outputs avoided severe harm, but the policy remained positive-only and failed specifically on images whose oracle action was negative. The small apparent joint-minus-control point difference is explained by the matched scalar and risk-disabled controls abstaining completely, not by material joint utility.
limitations: This is development-only evidence on the frozen S0 768 images and does not estimate confirmation or test performance.

The conclusion applies to the frozen three representatives, inference-visible state/action/RGB/deep summaries, head-only scope, optimizer, folds, seeds and calibration rule; it does not directly reject unrelated representations or end-to-end architectures.

The matched scalar and risk-disabled controls calibrated to zero coverage, so the increment contrast is scientifically valid under the frozen rule but cannot characterize active control-policy quality.
Confirmation, historical A1X-432 outcomes, canary and locked test were not accessed.
